column4: Empty string at Info.plist L51-52; app saves screenshots and covers via SaverGallery.saveImage (info_actions_menu.dart L88, player_item.dart L790).
image_picker README: App Store policy requires the entry; Kazumi is sideloaded on iOS and picks via PHPicker on iOS 14+ (no permission).
Gallery only (image_search_page.dart L136); no ImageSource.camera in the repo.
image_picker only imported for XFile (cross_file_converters.dart L5); picking uses wechat_assets_picker; on the App Store without the key.
Only CameraController uses enableAudio: false (ritual_camera_page.dart L289-292); camera_avfoundation asks for the mic only when enableAudio is true.

Info.plist has no UIBackgroundModes (aps-environment is set); app registers FirebaseMessaging.onBackgroundMessage (lib/main.dart L48). Firebase guide: "you must enable ... the Remote notifications background execution mode"; Apple: "To receive background notifications, you must add the remote notifications background mode". Its own Docs/ setup guides don't mention it.

camera is transitive via fl_lib (submodule @387f964) -> qr_code_dart_scan 0.14.0, whose only CameraController uses enableAudio: false (qr_code_dart_scan_controller.dart L233-236); camera is not in pubspec.yaml.
